The SHA is stable: `0EF92365C94BA8978F0CAC90CF0E873B4D823E979B86833DCA52390BE14AF817`, olean 609424 bytes at 2:19:46.

But note: the LastWriteTime of the .lean file wasn't printed (only olean row) — the Select-Object output showed only one row? It printed the file's Length/LastWriteTime header but only the olean row... Hmm, the output shows "Name Length LastWriteTime" table with only the olean. The earlier `Get-Item ... | Select-Object Length, LastWriteTime` output seems missing. Whatever; the olean at 2:19:46 was compiled from the current file (the last compile at ~2:19 was after the `open CategoryTheory` fix). Wait, the compile that produced EXIT=0 with all clean axioms was the one with the open fix — that ran at around 02:19; the olean timestamp 2:19:46 matches ✓.

Hmm, but actually the `.lean` file's SHA — I should double check that the file on disk is the version that compiled. Since the olean is newer than the last write presumably ✓ (the last write was the `open CategoryTheory` edit, then compile).

Let me verify by comparing timestamps explicitly. Also good news: the ledger mentions the same flaky environment note from another session, confirming my transient errors were environmental.

Now let me:
1. Append a concise ledger entry (following the existing format).
2. Send message to parent with the result.
3. Final answer.

Let me check the ledger's entry style more (look at a few entries' beginnings). Let me read a bit more of the tail (say 40 lines) to match format. Actually the tail shows bullet notes, so the file is a running log of dated/session-tagged notes. I'll append a new section with a header like "## S1797 ..." — let me check existing section headers.

Let me grep for "^## " in the ledger to see format.

content.arguments: {"code": "const r = await tools.pwsh({description: \"Inspect ledger headers\", command: \"Select-String -Path AUDIT_LEDGER.md -Pattern '^## ' | Select-Object -Last 8 LineNumber, Line | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String -Width 220; Write-Output '--- total lines ---'; (Get-Content AUDIT_LEDGER.md).Count; Write-Output '--- file times ---'; Get-Item tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1797MonoSecondActual.lean | Format-List Length, LastWriteTime; Get-Item .lake/build/lib/lean/tmp/sheaf/xif/paper/S1797MonoSecondActual.olean | Format-List Length, LastWriteTime\", timeoutMs: 120000});\nconsole.log(r.kind==='foreground'? r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text : JSON.stringify(r));\n", "description": "Check ledger headers and file timestamps"}
